faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) for a project-based research position in Rupnagar, Punjab.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in IIT Ropar recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the MeitY Project, offering a great opportunity for qualified engineering graduates.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for IIT Ropar JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is 20-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech in CSE/IT/AI/ECE or a B.E./B.Tech degree along with a valid CSIR/UGC NET or GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years. Suitable age relaxations are applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and Women candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary provided for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of 40,700/- INR.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIT Ropar JRF jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an online or offline interview.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website by filling out the application form and attaching all required educational and supporting documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and website link?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF link, online application link, and the official website link in the Important Links section of this article.
